observations.behavior: Peer presence arrives as a top-level presence frame with rows, full and server. It is not an ordinary topic event.
presence_ask sends ids limited to500 plus optional server. Own presence sends st, act, at and auto. Top-level read frames contain channel.

Presence tuples contain user ID, availability and optional activity. who_online takes sid, extra, since and returns now plus rows. A full poll uses since:null; off removes online state. Unknown native values are rejected rather than becoming Online.
heartbeat publishes the current explicit status and activity; the official fallback runs periodically. The native client publishes only a verified current-account preference while active.
wantedTopics includes all, own user topic and every joined server topic, plus the open server channel. Ordinary topic acknowledgments are not themselves a reconnect.

unread_counts_v2 is the supported base route and unread_counts_v3 the flagged newer route. Rows contain channel_id, unread, mentions and muted. The native implementation uses the observed v2 base route.

Compact unread events carry operation, message ID, channel ID and author ID, with optional everyone and here_to. Full content can arrive separately; native counters deduplicate by message ID and reconcile authoritative counts without reloading history.

A voice event is a complete per-server members snapshot with channel_id, user_id, muted, deafened and sharing. Native state replaces only that server roster and removes departed users; joining a call is not required to see this roster.

Mention tokens are <@UUID>, <@&UUID> and <#UUID>. Own ping eligibility uses direct user token, bounded @everyone, server-selected here_to, eligible assigned roles, or a known reply to self. Forwarded prefix suppresses ping eligibility. @here text alone is not proof of eligibility.
Mention history uses my_mentions_v2 when mentions_v2 is enabled, otherwise my_mentions, with lim:40. It is separate from my_inbox.

nativeGuards: Keep own account availability separate from peers; invisible never maps to Online.
Ignore stale account/scope/presence requests; optional errors preserve known data without inventing Online.
Protect reads and in-flight realtime changes against stale count responses.
Accept voice events only for an authenticated approved server subscription.
Hydrate mention/voice profiles through the shared official public42-column projection.
Native mention notices require verified DND/block/mute context; server notices also require verified server notification settings.
No automatic posting, CAPTCHA bypass, private browser/session reads or real-account test messages were performed.
Compact everyone/here pings may fetch exactly one authorized message by UUID, channel and author. Returned identities and timestamp must match; no POST or history reload is used.
Opaque compact direct/role pings reconcile counts and consult the authenticated own-mentions feed; only queued matching message/channel/author IDs can become a native notice.

Compact notice resolution rejects stale/future timestamps, superseded notices, account/navigation/read changes and already-shown IDs. Read-ID tombstones prevent compact-read-full ordering from restoring a cleared badge.
Partial subscription acknowledgments merge approved topics and intersect current desired topics; ordinary acknowledgments do not restart history resynchronization.
